title: TVAPI Plus custom live playlist source selection

policy.description: Collect public-channel candidates from readable lists already in catalog/live.json. Exclude social-room/replay/PPV-only feeds, expiring credentials, obvious VOD/promotional records, and private destinations. A readable list or a bounded media sample decoded by local FFmpeg is not proof of sustained live playback, client compatibility, or redistribution rights.

excluded_source_ids.zhuiju-fan-tai-ying-iptv: Image response, not a parseable plain playlist.
excluded_source_ids.zhuiju-fei-mao-iptv: Encrypted/non-plain payload; do not attempt to decrypt.
excluded_source_ids.backup-supprise-tvbox-live: Contains expiring signed stream URLs; avoid retaining them.
excluded_source_ids.backup-eastscreen-migu: The playlist endpoint itself carries an access token.
excluded_source_ids.backup-kulao-sports: Volatile event list; not part of the general channel build.
excluded_source_ids.backup-kulao-iptv: Mixed third-party re-stream index; not independently selected for this build.
excluded_source_ids.backup-ppv-sports: Pay-per-view/event list with unclear rights and volatile entries.
excluded_source_ids.backup-ottiptv-huyayu: Dynamic user live-room list, not a stable linear TV channel list.
excluded_source_ids.backup-ottiptv-douyu: Dynamic user live-room list, not a stable linear TV channel list.
excluded_source_ids.backup-ottiptv-bili: Dynamic user live-room list, not a stable linear TV channel list.
excluded_source_ids.backup-ottiptv-yy: Dynamic user live-room/rotation list, not a stable linear TV channel list.
excluded_source_ids.backup-ottiptv-mgtv: Event/program-specific temporary list; not a stable general channel feed.
excluded_source_ids.backup-wula-tv: URL contains an operator-issued access path; do not copy it into generated playlists or reports.
excluded_source_ids.zhuiju-vma-iptv-source: Download path resembles an opaque token/hash and is rejected by the shared path-secret safety rule.
excluded_source_ids.backup-fanmingming-ipv6: Mirrored list uses a hash-like filename; excluded rather than weakening the signed-path safety rule.
